examples.en: Jim was a most loving husband and father.
examples.zh: 吉姆是一个最富有爱心的丈夫和父亲。

examples.en: The children are very tactile with warm, loving natures.
examples.zh: 小孩子说话的同时爱用上充满温暖和爱心的触摸。

examples.en: Imagine loving your enemy and doing good to those who hated you.
examples.zh: 想像着爱你的敌人，为仇人做好事。
